feedback:
Acceptable on the inspected render evidence, with presentation refinements remaining. Independently checked the exact tetrahedron volume 1/6, octahedron volume 4/3, product 32/3, stretched volumes 12 and 8/9, normalized cube integral 1, and ball product approximately 17.545963. Source inspection confirms a shared deformation parameter with reciprocal polar coordinates, tetrahedra scaled about the common origin, and a numerically sampled manuscript lens. The scene hash matches verification.json. The manifest records completion without evaluator approval; the verification record reports 179.766667 seconds and successful full decoding.

The actual frames support the principal geometric explanations: t008.png and t018.png show coral cube faces, gold testing vectors and supporting-plane patches; t025.png clearly reveals the cyan polar inside the cube. In t034.png the selected tetrahedron stands out while seven companions are very faint. In t038.png its triangular base and perpendicular height are highlighted in gold, with readable B=1/2, h=1 and V=1/6 labels. t046.png presents the exact product cleanly. t058.png and t064.png show complementary flattening and elongation with readable formulas, although the contact dots alone provide limited geometric explanation of their pairing. t080.png has a legible ball comparison and a manageable sphere mesh. t096.png clearly places the violet lens on a tilted plane and labels it schematic.

The proof sequence maintains appropriate scope: t123.png isolates an exact cube-example simplex; t126.png shows the assembled union; t129.png states containment and distinguishes general-body gaps. The enlarged expressions in t138.png, t141.png and t143.png keep the targeted terms readable. These close-ups crop the contextual cube heavily, and t141.png places the initial S close to the left edge. A slightly wider term shot would preserve more context. t148.png and t154.png restore the complete, readable inequality. Attribution and the source caveat are clear in t170.png and t177.png.

Nonblocking revisions: replace literal caption notation such as '|Sigma_X|' and 'n!/4^n' with typeset symbols; lengthen several two-second explanatory beats, especially the convex-body definition at 82–84 seconds, by reallocating time within the duration limit. In t167.png and t170.png the small violet mixed Hanner example projects over the lower coral cube despite its separate world position. Move it into a clear screen region and label its construction so viewers can distinguish it immediately. The Hanner growth is appropriately identified as schematic in t160.png.
limitations: Verification covers supplied stills, inspected source and recorded render checks. Continuous playback was not inspected; stills and successful decoding do not establish smooth motion or readability throughout transitions.
Duration and full-video decoding results are reported by verification.json, not independently reproduced during this audit.
The manuscript's all-dimensional theorem, analytic estimate and formalization were not independently validated. This assessment is neither a formal proof certificate nor TypeSafe Jev approval.
